description: This PHP class subscribes to Symfony's kernel request event to intercept and process JSON request bodies, decoding them and adding the data to the request parameters.

classes.name: RequestBodySubscriber
classes.description: A subscriber class for handling JSON request bodies, decoding them, and injecting the data into the request parameters.

methods.name: getSubscribedEvents
methods.description: Returns an array configuring the listener for Symfony's kernel request event, setting the priority and callback method.

methods.name: onRequestEvent
methods.description: Handles the request event, checks for JSON content type, decodes JSON content, and adds it to request parameters.
